details: The earlier diagnostic used shared static hooks in two production classes, reflection, a separate trace framework, and a real ZkTestServer and proxy. It established the event sequence but is too invasive as a permanent test. The new test uses real ZooKeeper, the existing stress-test log4j delay pattern, DefaultConnectionStrategy and SocketProxy, without adding production test hooks. It still adds test infrastructure and relies on logs to control scheduling; Linux review and repeated fail-before/pass-after proof must assess its ordering and maintenance. The production ConnectionManager blob is identical to the previously tested fork offer. Diff is three scoped files including a changelog fragment. Windows did not run Gradle or tests. The new head is an ordinary child of contributor head de36597d and was verified on the fork after a non-force push. No public reply has been posted. The prior green diagnostic receipt does not cover the rewritten test.
